claim_one_line: Six of the 78 closed hyperbolic fillings of m004 in the |p|,q<=8 grid are arithmetic by the closed criterion (m004(+-5,1) = Meyerhoff, x^4-x-1 disc -283; (+-6,1) disc -59; (+-8,1) disc -31), the other 72 are not; B288's 'zero arithmetic' tested the cusped criterion (E82); 'zero keep Q(sqrt-3)' stands.
